rounds.fact: Slashdot popularized threaded, community-moderated comment sections years before that became standard, and getting linked from its front page could crash smaller sites entirely - a phenomenon known as 'the Slashdot effect.'
Groupon grew explosively fast off its daily-deal email format and turned down a reported $6 billion buyout offer from Google in 2010, a decision still debated years later.
Neopets combined virtual pet care with a whole in-game economy, and its blending of ads directly into games and content drew scrutiny as advertising to kids became a bigger issue.
WordPress launched in 2003 as a small blogging tool and eventually grew to power a huge share of all websites on the internet, blogs and full businesses alike.
WebCrawler, launched in 1994, was the first search engine to provide full-text search of the web, a basic feature that wasn't yet standard among its competitors.
